# afterhours

> A private dating app for working professionals in India, for the person you keep noticing at work or around your tech park. Nobody finds out unless it's mutual.

- Who it's for: working professionals across India, 18+.
- Status: coming soon. Join the waitlist at https://tryafterhours.app
- Privacy: we never share your data with your employer. Personal email only.
- Contact: support@tryafterhours.app
